x=\cos\phi,\qquad y=\sin\phi,\qquad z=1 .

along the path

\[

= (\cos^{2}\phi-\sin^{2}\phi)\,d\phi = \cos 2\phi\,d\phi .
\]

\[
\int_C \mathbf E\!\cdot d\mathbf l = \int_{0}^{\theta}\cos 2\phi\,d\phi
= \frac12\bigl[\sin 2\phi\bigr]_{0}^{\theta}
= \frac12\sin 2\theta .
\]

the work done on the charge is  

\[

\[
